Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Rustic Geometric Throw Pillow - 20 x 20 Inch, Earth Tones
Colors: Earth Tones
Made in USA and imported Patterned woven stripe brings a unique, southwester flair to your space in soft, earthy tones. Back of pillow is solid taupe-colored fabric. Hidden zipper at bottom of pillow. 20"L x 20"W Pillow cover and insert Spot clean. Pillow insert arrives in vacuum-sealed bag. Carefully remove insert from packaging. and let it fully expand before putting inside of pillow cover.
